Слово that можно опустить, кавычки исчезают.
Present Simple → Past Simple; Past Simple → Past Perfect
will → would, can → could, must → had to
tomorrow → the next day; yesterday → the day before
'I am tired and I will go home,' Ann said. → Ann said (that) she was tired and she would go home.
(Анна сказала, что устала и пойдёт домой.)
